We are so happy with this kids couch! Our grandkids love everything about it — they sit on it, lounge and nap on it, and most of all, they use it to build forts and little “houses” for hours of imaginative play. The sponge foam does take a few days to fully form, but putting it in a warm room and rotating the pieces helped it expand evenly. Once it settled, the couch became perfectly cushy and comfortable. It’s both durable and soft, which is exactly what we wanted. The material feels sturdy and well-made, and it holds up great even with constant climbing and rearranging. Overall, a wonderful, well-made piece for kids. Highly recommend!
